display_name: 独立自适应复数滤波恢复网络源域 GPU 训练
description: 逐窗口估计 33 抽头复数和共轭滤波器，结合独立局部波形残差；从随机初始化训练，无 DURA、F、TX 标签、V 或目标。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ; direct recovery uses only received IQ

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: AdaptiveInverseRecovery width32, 33 FIR taps, 31334 parameters, from scratch; zero heads reproduce received IQ
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: No upstream G or F initialization or teacher; frozen DURA only after source checkpoint for diagnostics and paired test
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Random initialization; no pretrained G, F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20; no source or target score selection

rows.method: Input-conditioned per-window widely-linear 33-tap FIR plus nonlinear waveform residual; no DURA input
rows.purpose: Train independent F-free network for 20 epochs
rows.seed_notes: New model initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611, fixed input caches and DURA seed 2026092701; optimizer ordering 2026110613.

notes: Train from scratch on paired source IQ, no DURA or F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target; frozen DURA loaded only after candidate freeze for source diagnostic and formal paired comparison.
Per-window 33-tap complex and conjugate FIR correction plus nonlinear time residual; zero output heads reproduce received IQ at initialization.
This is an independent recovery route and does not yet show scientific improvement; direct dual-domain source results motivated exploring conditional inversion.
Twenty fixed training epochs; all seven Phase1 test views and independent truth-last scoring regardless of source metrics.
